bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the meat probe {address}? Home Assistant listens to the probe's Bluetooth broadcasts directly – not via the Home Connect app or cloud, and without pairing. A Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy must be close to the oven. The data format was reverse engineered.

user.description: Choose a probe. It only broadcasts while it is out of its charger, and only a Bluetooth adapter or proxy near the oven can receive it.

manual.description: No probe is broadcasting right now. Take the probe out of its charger and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy is close to it, then try again, or enter its Bluetooth address.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as FC:25:3F:00:00:00.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported NEFF meat probe.
